errors.text_span: sie beginnt im Jahr 2000 bei etwa 0,25%
errors.evidence: The blue line for Germany starts at approximately 0.20% in the year 2000, not 0.25%. The value 0.25% corresponds to the starting point of the green line (Austria).

Describing the German line as 'stable' between 2016 and 2020 is incorrect. After falling to about 0.4% in 2016, the line continues to fall to a minimum around 2019 before rising again to the 2020 data point.
The data point for Germany in 2020 is approximately 0.30%, not 0.25%.
